turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're driving to my parents' place for the holidays and I can't decide how to do it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could drive straight through overnight while the kids sleep, about nine hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we leave after lunch, stop at a cheap hotel halfway, and finish the next morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner suggested putting the car on the overnight train, which costs more but nobody has to drive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then again, we could just skip driving, fly, and rent a car when we land.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: With kids, I'd pick the halfway hotel or the car train. The overnight drive puts a lot on whoever's behind the wheel, and flying plus a rental often ends up costing the most.
